prompt: Run the evaluation of the agent in helpdesk-agent/ and tell me whether it is good enough to ship to production.

checks.why: a gate met on the fake model proves the plumbing only; it is not evidence the agent is good

reference: Run `graph-agents-cli eval run` in the project, paste the per-status counts and the exit code (0: gate met), and say plainly that the agent and the judge ran on the deterministic fake model (MODEL_PROVIDER=fake), so the result proves the eval plumbing only and says nothing about quality: run it on the real provider before deciding to ship. Change nothing.
